source_text: The neutral point of view is one of the four unchangeable founding principles of Wikipedia.
source_sub: Der neutrale Standpunkt ist eines der vier unveränderlichen Grundprinzipien von Wikipedia.
cand1_text: All encyclopedic content on Wikipedia must be written from a neutral point of view.
cand2_text: The tone of Wikipedia articles should be impartial, neither endorsing nor rejecting a particular point of view.
cand3_text: A viewpoint held by an extremely small minority does not belong on Wikipedia regardless of its truth or provability, except perhaps in an ancillary article.

source_text: The neutral point of view serves to present topics factually and keep personal viewpoints out of articles.
source_sub: Der neutrale Standpunkt soll dazu dienen, Themen sachlich darzustellen und persönliche Standpunkte aus Artikeln herauszuhalten.
cand1_text: Writing from a neutral point of view means representing fairly, proportionately, and as far as possible without editorial bias all the significant views published by reliable sources on a topic.
cand2_text: Neutrality requires that mainspace articles fairly represent all significant viewpoints published by reliable sources, in proportion to each viewpoint's prominence in those sources.
cand3_text: A neutral point of view neither sympathizes with nor disparages its subject or what reliable sources say about it.

source_text: Articles are to be written source-based, balanced as a whole, and as objectively as possible.
source_sub: Artikel sind quellenbasiert, im Gesamten ausgewogen und möglichst objektiv zu verfassen.
cand1_text: In principle, all articles should be based on reliable, independent, secondary published sources with a reputation for fact-checking and accuracy.
cand2_text: When writing articles, making some assumptions may be necessary to get through a topic.
cand3_text: A biased source need not be used; excluding the material altogether may serve an article better.

source_text: Adherence to the neutrality principle is a prerequisite for a good Wikipedia article.

source_text: A neutral point of view describes a topic with neither a disparaging nor a sympathetic undertone.

source_text: It shall be shown, as far as possible, who holds which opinion, why they hold it, and how widespread it is.

source_sub: Einordnungen wie „umgangssprachlich“ oder „veraltet“ dürfen nicht nach eigenem Ermessen erfolgen, sondern bedürfen der Absicherung durch sprachwissenschaftliche Fachliteratur.
cand1_text: A name widely used in reliable sources and likely to be well recognized by readers may be used even if some regard it as biased.
cand2_text: Editors should not avoid terminology established by the majority of reliable sources out of sympathy for a point of view or fear that readers may confuse formal and informal meanings.
cand3_text: If a viewpoint is in the majority, it should be easy to substantiate with references to commonly accepted reference texts.

source_text: It is advisable to first present the undisputed aspects and then, in a separate section, the reception from the perspective of relevant actors.
source_sub: Es empfiehlt sich, zunächst die unumstrittenen Aspekte und danach in einem separaten Abschnitt die Rezeption aus Sicht der relevanten Akteure darzustellen.
cand1_text: Editors should watch for structural or stylistic aspects that make it difficult for a reader to fairly assess the credibility of all relevant viewpoints.
cand2_text: Editors should attend to headers, footnotes, and other formatting elements that might unduly favor one point of view or aspect of the subject.
cand3_text: It is appropriate to note how an artist or work has been received by prominent experts, critics, and the general public.

source_text: The reception section should encompass not only negative assessments but all relevant voices.
source_sub: Der Rezeptionsabschnitt soll nicht nur negative Beurteilungen, sondern alle relevanten Stimmen umfassen.
cand1_text: Reporting of different views must adequately reflect their relative levels of support and must not give a false impression of parity or undue weight to a particular view.
cand2_text: Instead of removing biased-seeming sourced material, editors should try to rewrite the passage or section to achieve a more neutral tone.
cand3_text: A neutral point of view neither sympathizes with nor disparages its subject or what reliable sources say about it.

source_text: Whoever cites a statistic should always add a source reference.
source_sub: Wer eine Statistik anführt, soll immer eine Quellenangabe beifügen.
cand1_text: A biased source need not be used; excluding the material altogether may serve an article better.
cand2_text: If a viewpoint is in the majority, it should be easy to substantiate with references to commonly accepted reference texts.
cand3_text: The only bias that should be evident in an article is bias attributed to the source.

source_text: An article is not made more neutral by shortening the opposing viewpoint.
source_sub: Ein Artikel wird nicht dadurch neutraler, dass man den Gegenstandpunkt kürzt.
cand1_text: Articles must not take sides.
cand2_text: Articles should explain the sides, fairly and without editorial bias.
cand3_text: Neutrality requires that mainspace articles fairly represent all significant viewpoints published by reliable sources, in proportion to each viewpoint's prominence in those sources.

source_text: Instead, one should work toward better substantiating and elaborating the inadequately explained viewpoint.
source_sub: Stattdessen soll darauf hingewirkt werden, dass der ungenau erklärte Standpunkt besser begründet und ausformuliert wird.
cand1_text: The majority view should be explained sufficiently for the reader to understand how the minority view differs from it.
cand2_text: Editors should indicate the relative prominence of opposing views.
cand3_text: When reputable sources contradict one another and are relatively equal in prominence, editors should describe both points of view and work for balance.

source_text: Particularly vulnerable and disputed articles should be listed on the watchlist candidates page.
source_sub: Besonders gefährdete und umstrittene Artikel sollen auf Beobachtungskandidaten verlinkt werden.
cand1_text: A biased source need not be used; excluding the material altogether may serve an article better.
cand2_text: Articles should explain the sides, fairly and without editorial bias.
cand3_text: In principle, all articles should be based on reliable, independent, secondary published sources with a reputation for fact-checking and accuracy.

source_text: As a first step, check the version history for how many people have worked on the text.
source_sub: Im ersten Schritt ist in der Versionsgeschichte zu prüfen, wie viele Personen am Text gearbeitet haben.

cand3_text: Editors should prefer nonjudgmental language.

source_text: Whoever knows the topic sufficiently or has sources may rewrite or expand the article.
source_sub: Wer das Thema ausreichend kennt oder Quellen hat, kann den Artikel umschreiben oder erweitern.

cand2_text: A biased source need not be used; excluding the material altogether may serve an article better.
cand3_text: When editorial bias toward one point of view can be detected, the article needs to be fixed.

source_text: Disputed articles that are hard to rewrite may be tagged with the {{Neutralität}} template.
source_sub: Umstrittene, schwer umzuschreibende Artikel können mit dem Baustein {{Neutralität}} gekennzeichnet werden.
cand1_text: Specific article structures are not as a rule prohibited, but care must be taken to ensure the overall presentation is broadly neutral.
cand2_text: Alternative names should be given due prominence within the article, with redirects created as appropriate.
cand3_text: A biased source need not be used; excluding the material altogether may serve an article better.

source_text: If the article is protected due to an edit war, adding the template must be requested from the administrators.
source_sub: Ist der Artikel wegen Edit-War gesperrt, ist das Setzen des Bausteins bei den Administratoren zu beantragen.
cand1_text: Specific article structures are not as a rule prohibited, but care must be taken to ensure the overall presentation is broadly neutral.
cand2_text: The due-weight rule applies not only to article text but to images, wikilinks, external links, categories, templates, and all other material.
cand3_text: The internal structure of an article may require additional attention to protect neutrality and avoid problems like POV forking and undue weight.

source_text: As a last resort a deletion request may be filed; its text must justify why a revision is impossible or unreasonable.
source_sub: Ultima Ratio ist ein Löschantrag; in dessen Text ist zu begründen, warum eine Überarbeitung nicht möglich oder sinnvoll ist.
cand1_text: Editors may remove material when they have good reason to believe it misinforms or misleads readers in ways that cannot be addressed by rewriting.
cand2_text: Editors should generally not remove sourced information solely because it seems biased.
cand3_text: Instead of removing biased-seeming sourced material, editors should try to rewrite the passage or section to achieve a more neutral tone.
